title: Push Story Natural/Random relocation not covered
reality: v2.3.5 moved the Narrative Director's Natural/Random progression choice ONTO the Push Story button: clicking it opens a Naturally/Randomly selector that arms the chosen mode for the next response. This replaced the mode controls previously buried in Chat Settings > Agents > Narrative Director, the add-agent setup, and the Narrative Director editor's Story Push Mode default.
fix: In references/agents.md, extend the `director` (Narrative Director) bullet with a (v2.3.5) note: Story Push Mode is no longer configured in Chat Settings > Agents > Narrative Director — the Naturally/Randomly choice now lives on the Push Story button and arms only the next response. Any click-path advice pointing at the old Narrative Director setting is stale.

title: Illustrator per-chat Images Per Generation setting missing
reality: v2.3.5 (#3966) added a per-chat 'Images Per Generation' setting to Illustrator in Conversation, Roleplay, and Game, generating up to four sequential image variants through the existing provider queue and gallery pipeline. Generated image attachments were also enlarged in Conversation and Roleplay while staying within the chat viewport.
fix: Add to the `illustrator` bullet in references/agents.md: (v2.3.5, #3966) per-chat Images Per Generation, up to 4 sequential variants via the existing provider queue. Relevant to cost advice — a user who raises this multiplies image spend per trigger.

title: Roleplay Gallery Animate single-shot animation director missing
reality: v2.4.0 (#4311) added a single-shot animation director to Roleplay Gallery Animate. The selected Prompt Model plans motion, camera behavior, supported dialogue, sound effects, ambience, and an ending hold from the exchange behind the Illustrator image; the existing image remains frame zero and Game Storyboard behavior is unchanged. Its duration-aware instructions are editable under Settings > Generations > Video Generation Prompt Overrides with ${durationSeconds} support.
fix: Document in references/agents.md near the storyboard/illustrator entries, and cross-reference from architecture.md's scene-video section: Animate is now model-directed rather than a bare image-to-video call, and its prompt is user-overridable with a ${durationSeconds} placeholder. Explicitly note Game Storyboard behavior did NOT change, so the two are not interchangeable.

title: Per-chat Illustrator image-connection override only in SKILL.md deltas
reality: v2.4.0 (#4057) added a Roleplay Illustrator image connection override in Chat Settings, separate from the prompt-writing connection, falling back to the Illustrator Agent's configured image model. SKILL.md's release-deltas section names it, but references/agents.md (the `illustrator` entry) and architecture.md's Connection section — where a reader would actually look — do not.
fix: Add the override to the `illustrator` bullet in references/agents.md and to the Connection 'Defaults' paragraph in architecture.md. Emphasise the split: one connection writes the prompt, a different one renders the image.

title: Agent-assigned Local Sidecar on-demand start missing
reality: v2.3.5 (#3960) allows an Agent explicitly assigned to Local Sidecar to start that runtime on demand even when the global tracker-sidecar default is disabled.
fix: Add a one-line note to the agent-connection/tuning material in references/agents.md. Prevents the wrong diagnosis when a user reports 'my sidecar agent runs even though I disabled the sidecar default' — that is intended behavior for an explicit per-agent assignment.

title: Radial-gauge tracker layout documented only in decision-guide
reality: v2.4.0 added an optional radial-gauge layout for Persona and Character tracker stats, with editable icons, percentage readouts, subtle low-stat warnings, and improved featured-card spacing and thought placement. references/decision-guide.md mentions it; references/agents.md's tracker entries (character-tracker, persona-stats) do not.
fix: Add the radial-gauge option to the `character-tracker` and `persona-stats` bullets in references/agents.md, tied to the existing structured {name,value,max,color} stat shape those entries already describe.

title: World Maps navigation relocation not noted
reality: v2.4.0 kept World Maps navigation inside the Agents tab and Chat Settings by removing its dedicated launchers from the Chats sidebar and top bar.
fix: Append to the `hierarchical-maps` (World Maps) bullet in references/agents.md. Low severity but it invalidates any click-path instruction that says 'open World Maps from the sidebar'.
